name: M6.FiberSum.sum_by_fibers
statement: ∀ (α β : Type) [Fintype α] [Fintype β] (L : α → β) (w : β → Polynomial ℤ), M6.FiberSum.pullbackSum L w = M6.FiberSum.fiberSum L w
guidance: Reindex the finite domain sum by fibers using finite sum_fiberwise; each fiber has constant weight, hence cardinality times that polynomial. Return tactic lines only, no leading by.
